title: Conquering Nigeria’s Harsh Climate: Dawnice 400kWh Outdoor Cabinet Empowers Church Microgrid Stability (March 2026)
summary: A 400kWh outdoor cabinet built for a church microgrid in Nigeria, sized for high ambient temperatures.
challenge: Local churches average 9.3 blackouts a day and carry high diesel costs. Services and community programmes stop when the grid does, and the equipment has to survive a hot, humid climate.
solution: A 400kWh outdoor cabinet rated for the site's ambient conditions, configured as a community microgrid.
result: Continuous power through the daily outages without running diesel through every interruption.
